## 中文原文

你早上起晚了，匆匆忙忙洗漱、换衣服，出门发现没带钥匙和手机，又跑回去拿，结果赶到地铁站时刚好错过一班地铁，只能在站台等下一班，心里有点着急，怕上班迟到。

## English translation

I overslept this morning and rushed through getting washed and changed.

I’d only just stepped out the door when I realized I’d left my keys and phone behind, so I had to dash back inside to grab them.

By the time I got to the subway station, I’d just missed the train, so I was stuck waiting on the platform.

I’m feeling pretty stressed because I’m worried I’ll be late for work.
